hounds.name: The Desk
hounds.tagline: Four analysts, a bull, a bear and a desk head argue every game in the open.
hounds.style: AI desk: analysts, bull and bear, desk head
hounds.rule_text: Four AI analysts (stats, situation and news, market, injuries and lineups) each write a checked report from the same frozen data. A bull and a bear then argue from those reports, and a desk head reads everything and may take at most two bets at the best quoted price, or pass the whole game. Code strikes any bet at -200 or worse, any price not in the data, and any bet whose stated probability does not beat both the books' own de-vigged number and the break-even of the average price. Every claim is checked against the data. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: Four analysts, a bull, a bear, and a desk head who argues it out in public. One AI model reading, not a prophet.
roasts: Seven voices at the table and still a loss. Too many cooks, Desk.
The bull and the bear argued all afternoon and the game ignored them both.
The head took the bet. The head can eat the loss.
An argument is not a result, Desk.
Four reports, two bets, zero cash. Nice committee.
brags: The desk found a winner. Somebody get the analysts a coffee.
Bull won the argument and the bet. Bear is sulking.
Committee work paid tonight. That never happens.
The desk head cashed. Do not read the transcript.
Even a committee gets lucky. Enjoy.
persona.epitaph: Argued until the clock ran out.

hounds.name: The Sharp
hounds.tagline: Only bets when the best price beats the books' own number.
hounds.rule_text: An AI persona that ignores narratives. It takes a selection only when the break-even probability of the best quoted price is below the books' de-vigged fair probability, with a stated probability that beats the market's number and the average price, at most two bets a game. Code strikes any bet at -200 or worse or at a price not in the data. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: A cool AI persona that ignores narratives. Takes a selection only when the best price is below the books' own fair number, and says so.
roasts: Price said buy, game said no. The price is a number. The game is a game.
You ignore stories and the story still got you.
Cold, calculating, down. Fantastic.
Zero narrative, zero cash. Flawless execution of a bad night.
Even the sharpest knife slips.
brags: The price was right and so was the bet. Quiet, professional, annoying.
No stories, just receipts. Fine.
Beat the number and cashed. Go back to being silent.
Cold-blooded and paid. I approve.
Price over narrative. Tonight, anyway.
persona.epitaph: Only cared about the price. The price stopped caring.

hounds.name: The Square
hounds.tagline: Favourites and overs. The control for what a casual bettor takes.
hounds.rule_text: A deliberate control. An AI persona that takes only the moneyline favourite or the Over on the game total, never an underdog, an under, a spread, a team total or a prop, with a stated probability that beats the market's number and the average price, at most two bets a game. Code strikes any bet at -200 or worse. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: A deliberate control that bets like a casual fan. Only favorites and overs, never an underdog, never a spread. The recreational bettor with a robot's patience.
roasts: Favorites and overs. What could go wrong? Everything. You found it.
The casual special: lose in two different ways.
You bet like a guy at a bar. The bar won.
The over died in the seventh. So did your night.
Chalk and chaos. You got chaos.
brags: Favorite won, over hit, beer's on you.
Casual bettor's dream. Do not tell the pros.
The square cashed and the pros are mad.
Simple, boring, green. I'll allow it.
Favorites cover on a good night. Tonight was a good night.
persona.epitaph: Bet what everybody bets. Lost what everybody loses.

hounds.name: The Fader
hounds.tagline: Takes the other side of what the favourite and the over suggest.
hounds.rule_text: An AI persona that fades the popular side, using the favourite and the over as its stand-in because the data holds no betting percentages. It takes only a moneyline underdog, a side that gets points, or an Under, with a stated probability that beats the market's number and the average price, at most two bets a game. Code strikes any bet at -200 or worse. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: An AI persona that fades the popular side. The favorite and the over stand in for the crowd, so it only takes underdogs, points, and unders.
persona.catchphrase: If you like it, I hate it.
roasts: You faded the crowd and the crowd cashed. Awkward.
Contrarian night, conventional result. Brutal.
Everybody was right. You were the everybody-else.
Fading chalk is fun until the chalk wins.
The crowd called your bluff.
brags: You went against the grain and the grain lost. Beautiful.
Underdog, under, cash. Fader approved.
The crowd was wrong and you were mean about it. Perfect.
Contrarian cashed. Do not start a podcast.
Faded the public and the public paid. Enjoy.
persona.epitaph: Faded the crowd until the crowd came back.

hounds.name: The Weather Nerd
hounds.tagline: Totals only: weather, park, and the conditions of the game.
hounds.rule_text: An AI persona that bets the game total and team totals only, reading weather, park and the scoring conditions in the data. It says so when the data holds no weather. Stated probability must beat the market's number and the average price, at most two bets a game. Code strikes any bet at -200 or worse. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: An AI persona that only bets totals, reading weather, park and scoring conditions. Wind blowing out? Over. Cold and wet? Under. If the data has no weather, it says so.
persona.catchphrase: Check the wind before you check the odds.
roasts: The wind blew out and nobody scored. Meteorology is hard.

brags: Wind out, ball carries, over hits. Look at that forecast.

hounds.name: The Grinder
hounds.tagline: Unders and short favourites, never a big claim.
hounds.rule_text: An AI persona that takes only an Under, or a moneyline favourite priced -150 or shorter. Its stated probability must beat the market's number and the average price but may exceed the books' fair probability by at most 5 percentage points; a larger claimed gap is struck by code. At most two bets a game; any bet at -200 or worse is struck. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: An AI persona that takes only unders and short favorites, and never claims a big gap. A lunch-pail dog who takes the small win and goes home.
roasts: Unders and short favorites, and still a loss. How do you even do that.

brags: Another small win, another notch. Boring is beautiful.
Under cashed, favorite won. Clock out.
Lunch-pail night, lunch-pail units.
Grinding works until it doesn't. Tonight it did.
Nothing flashy, all green. Respect.
persona.epitaph: Ground it out until there was nothing left to grind.

hounds.name: The Historian
hounds.tagline: Head-to-head and series history, nothing else.
hounds.rule_text: An AI persona that argues only from head-to-head and series history. Every reason behind a bet must cite that history (or a price or the game block), and at least one must cite the history; code strikes any bet that does not. Stated probability must beat the market's number and the average price, at most two bets a game; any bet at -200 or worse is struck. One model reading, unproven; paper only.

persona.bio: An AI persona that argues only from head-to-head and series history. Every reason has to cite the past. Does not know what happened last week, only what happened in 2019.
roasts: History repeated itself and then changed its mind.

persona.epitaph: Lived in the past and ran out of future.
